criteria.text: Patient has a diagnosis of rickets.

notes: Partial encoding from OCR of scanned AK Ergocalciferol Oral Drops Criteria Version 1; Last updated 06/04/09. Source PDF is image-only (HP MFP); text recovered via tesseract 2026-09-27.
effective_date uses Last updated 2009-06-04 (replaces ingestion stub 2009-01-01).
Product: oral solution 8000 units/mL, 60 mL. Preferred medication listed as Drisdol; non-preferred Calciferol.
PDF frames ergocalciferol as a dietary supplement under DSHEA that cannot be labeled to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease; the sole encoded approval criterion is a rickets diagnosis.
Authorization (notes only): coverage may be approved for up to 1 year.
Distinct from vitamin-d-50 (Drisdol 50,000 IU capsule criteria). Reciprocal alternative link to vitamin-d-50 for the high-dose capsule pathway.
